The complete 77-command gate in docs/checks/phase-08.json matches tools/check_phase.py commands_for(8) exactly, every command exits 0, and the report binds source_sha256 835b739b with source_unchanged true; I recounted both the command set (7+19+3+2+2+12+... = 77) and the 77 recorded exit codes. Both new regressions are proven to have failed on the preceding source and to pass now (docs/checks/phase-08-build-output-fix.json:12-32, 21 CI tests), and the remote cause is directly substantiated rather than asserted: docs/checks/phase-08-ci-run-10/phase-08.json is the captured parent report showing 56 CI commands passing and command 57 failing with repository_byte_limit, with 4,023,429,395 source bytes from 3,325 generated files under contracts/native-probes/target (build-output-diagnosis.json:11-16). None of these is misrepresented and none can be satisfied before this review, so they are outstanding obligations and limitations rather than blocking defects. I found no blocker or high finding.

findings.description: Milestone 8's "controlled live workflows and cleanup" is only partly satisfied. contracts/qualification.json:53-67 records 17 live-verified of 448 methods with liveByStatus service_contract_rejection 2 and permission_prerequisite 3, and the live receipt carries cleanupState "not_needed" (contracts/qualification.json:51) only because iam.scopes.create and gateway.workspaces.provision were rejected with 400 before ownership. The entire downstream chain (scope read/update/delete, absence verification, workspace archival and owned-binding removal) therefore has no successful service execution, and the 400 cause remains unestablished with an SDK request-shape defect explicitly not excluded (tools/qualification.py:27). This is recorded honestly and nothing is promoted on offline parity, so it is a scope limitation, not a misstatement.
findings.required_fix: Keep both operations and every dependent mutation/cleanup path explicitly live-unqualified. Before any stable promotion, obtain private diagnostics for the two 400 responses, reconcile the traffic-derived IAM and Gateway provisioning request contracts against a vendor specification, and record a new source-bound receipt that actually exercises create/read/update/delete plus confirmed cleanup.

findings.description: The phase-2 limitation remote-ci-execution is due in phase 8 and is still open: run 9 at bde0f4e5 failed contracts-and-package, run 10 at 6fe1fac failed the same job on repository_byte_limit (docs/checks/phase-08-ci-run-10/qualification-capture-receipt.json:12-23), and the reviewed source 835b739b is uncommitted, so it has no remote execution at all. Remotely, only the first 56 of 77 gate commands have ever been observed passing (docs/checks/phase-08-ci-run-10/phase-08.json:31-1427); dependency policy, the ten remaining Rust feature sets, both package checks, the four cross checks and tracing stress have never run on a runner. Three optional native-host jobs remain unexecuted. All of this is labeled accurately in docs/CI.md:116-166 and docs/RELEASE.md:84-88, and the push by construction follows this review.
findings.required_fix: After this review, push the reviewed commit, run both scripts/check-package.py --require-clean proofs on 1.89.0 and 1.99.0, and retain a source-bound Forgejo run for 835b739b in which contracts-and-package completes; only then resolve the remote-ci-execution limitation and push the v0.1.0 tag with verified remote peel.

findings.description: The new default build-directory branch was not exercised by an actual Cargo build in the accepted gate. Both native-export receipts record cargoTargetDir "/build/rust/target", i.e. the host's externally configured directory, so scripts/check-native-exports.py:44-45 took the caller-choice path. The default branch is covered only by a mocked-subprocess regression (tools/test_ci.py:69-101) plus synthetic ignore/fingerprint regressions; docs/checks/phase-08-build-output-fix.json:46 states this limit explicitly. The .gitignore change independently neutralizes the failure mode, so the residual risk is that the default placement itself is unproven under real Cargo.
findings.required_fix: Run scripts/check-native-exports.py once with CARGO_TARGET_DIR unset (or capture it from the next remote run, where it is unset) and retain a receipt whose cargoTargetDir is the repository's own target directory, alongside a passing private-material receipt check in the same workspace.

findings.description: The phase-8 review ledger is internally inconsistent for an in-progress phase. phases[8].accepted_source_sha256 is 3d2c6caf (attempt-04's source) and phases[8].reviews lists only attempts 02 and 04 (lines 479-482), while milestones.claude_review (lines 649-656) cites docs/reviews/phase-08-attempt-06.json at source 3e771978 and current_source_review (lines 1386-1392) names attempt 7 as required. tools/review_phase.py writes accepted_source_sha256 and appends reviews only on --advance, so these two fields are hand-maintained and now point at a snapshot that is neither current nor the latest accepted review. This is excluded bookkeeping and does not affect any gate, but it makes the accepted-review pointer misleading on a quick read.
findings.required_fix: Make the accepted-review pointer unambiguous: either append the accepted attempt-05/06 paths to phases[8].reviews and update accepted_source_sha256/accepted_score to the latest accepted snapshot, or rename those fields for phase 8 (for example last_accepted_review_source_sha256) so the in-progress state cannot be read as the current acceptance.

findings.description: The bounded-evidence inventory has no visible headroom signal before its fail-closed limit.
